title: Timing with Ropes
summary: Change how you use the tool: two ends halves the time.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: You have two ropes. Each takes exactly one hour to burn, but they burn unevenly.
points: You have two ropes. Each takes exactly one hour to burn, but they burn unevenly.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: You cannot cut by length because the burn is uneven.
But you can light a rope at both ends.
points: You cannot cut by length because the burn is uneven.

steps.title: The method: Use both ends
sentences: A rope lit at both ends burns in 30 minutes, because the two flames meet in the middle.
Light rope A at both ends and rope B at one end at the same time.
When A is gone, 30 minutes have passed.
points: A rope lit at both ends burns in 30 minutes, because the two flames meet in the middle.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: At 30 minutes, rope B has 30 minutes left.
Now light the other end of B.
It will burn out in 15 minutes, giving 30 plus 15 equals 45 minutes.
points: At 30 minutes, rope B has 30 minutes left.

quiz.q: A rope burns in 60 minutes. Lit at both ends, it burns in about:
quiz.why: The flames meet in the middle.
